summary: Frontend E2E testing of Goa Yatra (TTG Travels) 5-page brochure site completed. All 57 assertions passed across Home, Cars-with-Driver, Self-Drive, Group Travel, and About & Contact pages. Verified header/hero/footer CTA hrefs (tel:+917249216623 and https://wa.me/917249216623), all pricing tables & data (chauffeur sedan ₹2,500; hycross ₹10,500; Fortuner Legender ₹8,000 / deposit ₹10,000; 13 self-drive rows; 11 booking notes; tempo 6k/9k/14k; urbania 10k/14k/20k), FAQ accordion opens (aria-expanded=true), active nav link color rgb(92,26,26) maroon on /self-drive, map iframe embeds google.com/maps with Porvorim, mobile sticky bar and hamburger menu on 390px viewport, and no console/runtime errors on any route.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js catch-all route '*' renders Home instead of a dedicated 404 page — minor UX concern, acceptable for brochure site.

Code is clean, componentised properly (Header/Footer/MobileStickyBar/PricingTable/CTAButtons), pricing data centralised in /src/data/pricing.js, brand/contact constants in /src/lib/site.js — good separation of concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React marketing site with no backend. All data-testid selectors used in the review request are present and correct. Playwright test flow (single script) covers all 5 routes, hrefs, pricing values, FAQ interaction, mobile sticky bar (appears after scroll > 320px on 390-wide viewport), and hamburger menu. No console errors captured. Nav active state uses inline color rgb(92, 26, 26) = #5C1A1A.
